quote_json: "System.NullReferenceException is thrown and no further steps are executed"
notes: Read with the surrounding clauses: 12.8.16.6 p. 216 evaluates a delegate-typed source, then explicitly requires NullReferenceException for null before allocation. This source is statically delegate-typed, not a dynamic binding failure or method group. csc evaluates the source once and instead throws System.ArgumentException; the previous destination reference is preserved and the source body is never invoked. The compatible nonnull mutant differs on the null and new-result checks. First tested conforming version: none.

quote_json: "The body of an anonymous function is not affected"
notes: This witness compares the body's overflow and value with a nonconstant addition outside the checked block in the same compilation. csc's /checked- default addition wraps; its anonymous body instead throws OverflowException. The mutant removes the anonymous boundary, so the checked addition fails during delegate creation, a distinct failure. First tested conforming version: none.

Read with the surrounding clauses: 12.8.21 p. 225 permits independently optional unmanaged_type and constant_expression before an initializer; Annex A pp. 591-592 repeats that grammar. p. 225 infers omitted type by best common type and permits a present count equal to the number of elements. Here the two int elements infer unmanaged int and match count 2 in a whole local initializer; the result stays within the function-member safe-context of 16.4.12.7. csc rejects the bracketed count with CS8381 when type is omitted. quote_json: "a named_entity_target to have the type dynamic"
notes: Read with the surrounding clauses: 12.8.22 p. 227 makes receiver the simple-name named_entity_target; its declared type is dynamic. p. 227 requires compile-time lookup and explicitly forbids that target type, independently of the no-evaluation rule. csc accepts receiver.Number without looking up Number. Changing only the receiver type to Program repairs the restriction and changes the field-use diagnostic from CS0169 to CS0649. Both sources compile on csc; the diagnostic delta is not sensitivity on a conforming compiler. First tested conforming version: none.

quote_json: "expression shall be implicitly convertible to System.Exception"
notes: Source declares a valid implicit conversion to Exception, with operand and conversion traces. csc rejects throw Make() with CS0155. Both 12.16p. 258 and 13.10.6p. 327 allow implicit conversion; the latter runtime reference adds no contrary operand restriction. Replacing only the operand with an explicit Exception cast passes and prints OK 2, proving the conversion and remaining program valid.

notes: The prohibition at p. 259 applies to any declared variable, not only an inferred variable. The otherwise-equivalent inferred deconstruction is rejected with CS0841. Removing the reference while retaining explicit declarations is the focused repair.
